info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Transaction Authorization Management API
info.description: The Transaction Authorization Management API facilitates the updating of transaction authorization details, allowing for seamless adjustments to important banking transactions. This endpoint supports the modification of parameters related to transaction approvals, ensuring that users can manage their transaction workflows effectively. Typical consumers include financial institutions and banking applications that require dynamic adjustments for transactions based on evolving business rules or customer needs. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance payment processing and compliance mechanisms within their applications.

patch.description: This endpoint allows the user to authorize a cross-channel transaction by providing the transaction ID. The operation modifies the existing transaction status based on the input data.
